<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets-and-relics"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=d6c5595e-226f-4fc8-bd3a-a879f16030fe <nowiki>Magic / Melee preset</nowiki>]<nowiki>
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fd6c5595e-226f-4fc8-bd3a-a879f16030fe.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="role-information"><ins><nowiki>Role Information</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Mage/Melee should be limited to only free(sc) or hammer roles as well as only 1 per team for optimal performance. It provides strong damage for p1-3 and zaros but woll not attack minions p3 and severely lacks pillar damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
